resources.string: Types your dictated text into the text field you are using, and can read the text you have selected in that field when you ask. Personal Voice looks only at the focused field, and only when you finish dictating or capture a selection. It does not read, record, or store anything else on screen.
Shown while the floating mic is on.
Tap the mic for quick actions. Hold it in any app to dictate. Audio is recorded only while you hold it.
Tap for actions, hold to dictate
Open Personal Voice to use the floating mic.
